newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool tops up on Australian primary prices.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool tops up on Australian primary prices.

text.p: The progressive increase in Australian raw wool values pulled tops prices up by four to ten pence per kg, Bradford market sources said on Monday.
Traders said official forecasts suggesting a sustained growth in primary market prices plus evidence of a limited improvement in underlying demand brought tops buyers back to the table.
The Bradford market generally accepted ABARE (Australian Bureau of Agricultural and Resource Economics) predictions of a seasonal average of 600 cents per kg for raw wool, they said.
But pure English wool tops were unmoved by moderate increases for raw wool at Wednesday's UK sale and all were quoted unchanged. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
